name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preselects the sharpest frames before upscaling, cutting wasted compute on blurry or redundant frames—directly lifting output quality without extra hardware. The trade-off is a small added latency from the depth analysis, but the net gain in clarity per frame justifies it.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem isn’t blur—it’s the model’s inability to preserve identity in low-resolution or heavily compressed frames. The real risk is wasting time on a tool that addresses the wrong symptom while ignoring the actual bottleneck: the base model’s face reconstruction weakness. Test it by running InstantX-ComfyUI on a sample of EXCAVA’s worst face outputs—if face fidelity doesn’t improve, scrap it and push for a face-specific super-resolution model instead.
